summary: The diff implements Iterator.from in its own file, in spec step order. GetIteratorFlattenable (string-primitive variant) is a local helper: it throws a TypeError for non-object, non-string input and then performs GetMethod(@@iterator), Call, the is-Object check and GetIteratorDirect with `?` propagation. Step 2 uses ordinary_has_instance against %Iterator%, step 3 returns the iterator when true, and steps 4-6 build the wrapper through create_wrap_for_valid_iterator. Every abrupt completion is propagated. Nothing is hardcoded or keyed on test inputs, and the not-implemented paths in the gate report are honest. No problems found.
